en-US.description:
I was told to eat whatever I wanted, so I went to eat something I really wanted...

A 16-month-old little one eating this deliciously...?🤣🤣

She only has 6 teeth so far... but ribs are love, indeed🥹

In the end, Sera ate almost a full serving of nutritious ribs and 1/3 of a bowl of rice, and even ate a mango when she got home;;

From now on, whenever I go to a meat restaurant, I'm definitely going to order an extra serving...🙈✨

📍 Yet Hanwoo Goeul (Ssangyong-dong, Cheonan, paid for with my own money)

일본인이 한국으로 여행 오면 꼭 먹는 음식 중

제가 부추를 좋아하기도 하지만 소스에 부추를 같이 먹으니까

en-US.title: My Japanese wife, who doesn't usually eat Sundae Gukbap, enjoying it at the 5-day market..
en-US.description:
During the late stages of my pregnancy, I really wanted to go to a five-day market or a regular market, but I couldn't because I was too tired. I told myself I would go after giving birth, but it ended up becoming even harder, haha. Still, now that Sera is starting to communicate a little, I feel like we can go to a variety of places, so I went with confidence... but... I guess she wanted to hold the plate herself... my daughter 🥹🥹🥹. Still, thanks to her behaving well as soon as we started eating, I was able to enjoy the delicious sundae gukbap I had been craving! The sundae was so tasty that I wanted to keep eating it, so I think I'll try ordering just sundae next time! It was a shame we went so late... but next time, let's go when Sera can eat too 😻

Sera is usually quiet, but I tried adding a little bit of *Pweeeeeeng* to today's video haha.

I'll have to show this to Sera when she grows up hehe.

I usually eat naengsam (cold pork belly) at home for a more economical price, so I never thought it was as good or even as good...???
So I'd never been to a naengsam specialty restaurant, but this one was so famous...so I decided to visit🥹
